title: Build-and-Find: An Effort-Aware Protocol for Evaluating Agent-Managed Codebases
abstract: arXiv:2605.06136v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most coding-agent benchmarks ask whether generated code behaves correctly. That remains essential, but repository-level engineering is increasingly agent-managed: one agent writes a repository, and later agents inspect, audit, or extend it as working context. In that setting, a generated repository is not only an answer to a task but also a communication artifact for future work. Even when strong agents nearly satisfy the visible behavioral objective, repositories can differ in how clearly they expose the intended behavior and design choices behind that behavior. We introduce Build-and-Find to evaluate whether downstream agents can efficiently recover intended choices from generated repositories. For each task, a builder creates a codebase from a hidden specification; a finder receives only the codebase and a specification-traced question bank. translated_title: Build-and-Find：一种用于评估智能体管理代码库的工作量感知协议
translated_abstract: 大多数编码智能体基准测试关注的是生成代码的行为是否正确。这依然至关重要，但仓库级工程正日益由智能体管理：一个智能体编写仓库，而后续的智能体则将其作为工作上下文进行检查、审计或扩展。在这种设置下，生成的仓库不仅是任务的答案，也是供后续工作使用的沟通产物。即使强大的智能体几乎满足了可见的行为目标，不同仓库在多大程度上清晰地暴露了该行为背后的意图和设计选择也可能存在差异。我们提出 Build-and-Find 来评估下游智能体能否高效地从生成的仓库中恢复出预期的设计选择。对于每个任务，构建者根据隐藏的规范创建一个代码库；查找者仅接收该代码库和一个带规范溯源的问题库。该协议将行为正确性与产物侧的可恢复性区分开来，并报告恢复……
tldr: 该论文提出 Build-and-Find 协议，通过“构建者-查找者”框架，首次将智能体生成代码库的评估从行为正确性扩展到可恢复性，衡量下游智能体能否以较低工作量从代码库中高效还原出背后的设计意图。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Build-and-Find, an effort-aware builder-finder protocol that extends evaluation of agent-generated codebases beyond behavioral correctness, measuring whether downstream agents can efficiently recover the intended design choices embedded in the repository.
